ABOUT FORTIMESH

Strength that secures your future.

A Rwanda-based supplier focused on steel, gabion solutions and construction materials for the projects that shape our communities.

OUR FOCUS

Reliable materials.
Practical service.

FORTIMESH AND STEELS RWANDA LTD describes its work as supplying steel products, gabion solutions and a broad range of construction materials. Its published company profile names contractors, engineers, developers, institutions and individual clients among those it serves across Rwanda.

Whether your requirement starts with a drawing, a bill of quantities or a straightforward material list, a clear specification is the best first step. This site helps you identify the relevant product family and prepare that request.
